note: Oglala National Grassland (Nebraska NF & Grasslands), NW of Crawford in the badlands; trailhead for the one-mile interpretive loop, the Bison Trail to Hudson-Meng (3 mi) and the Great Plains Trail; replica 1929 sod house. Gravel spurs off a gravel loop with picnic tables, fire rings and grills; no water, bring your own. Reached by Toadstool Road (11.4 mi of gravel from NE Hwy 2, 4.2 mi N of Crawford) and FS Road 902 (1.4 mi): the Forest Service says the roads are very difficult when wet and to wait until they are dry. The Forest Service gives no site length; a camper reported a 25-ft trailer fit, just barely (undated). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2025-12-23) and recreation.gov read: 12 sites (stored 6), $15/night with $7.50 extra vehicle, open year-round, vault toilets, no water, all sites non-electric and not reservable (rec.gov carries it only for Scan & Pay), Senior/Access 50% off. Sites 6 -> 12; fees, season, booking, facilities and electric now manual. Road: gravel, FS advises waiting for dry roads (no 4WD/high-clearance wording). No closures. Pin at the loop entrance.
